## Why

The `conformance 3/3 — fix check` of #5403 returned **FIX-DEFECTIVE** ([blocker](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/4867#issuecomment-5908534539)). The operator answered **Q10: A** ([answer](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/4867#issuecomment-5910328120)): one small fix PR, then straight to the security pass, with no fourth conformance run.

The defect: `issue_body` writes the command's shape on the `**Pattern:**` line, outside the fenced example, where the filer's markers are read. The shape keeps a segment's command word and a script operand literally (`_segment_shape`). So a quoted marker as the command word put marker text where markers are read.

## Change

- `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`
  - New `_pattern_line(pattern)`, which renders the `**Pattern:**` line through the existing `_reason_line` guard: one line, with `<!--` escaped as `<\!--`. `issue_body` uses it.
  - The shape itself, and so every signature, is unchanged. Only the rendering changes.
  - The module docstring now says the shape is guarded too.
- `tests/test_permission_prompt_duplicates.py`: pinning tests for the four commands from the blocker, plus a fifth case. A quoted newline in a command word

2026-09-30T11:54:47.1478403Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5627-resolver-private-model-index-plan.md` (progress log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5627-resolver-private-model-index.md`; final PR #5637).

The source-repo conflict resolver failed closed whenever its model ran `git add` on the permitted conflicted file. The model shared the live merge index, and both attempt-scope guards require that index to stay unchanged. `_resolver_scope_state` hashes the index at `:585-587` of the pre-fix script, and `_resolver_attempt_state` checks `ls-files --stage` at `:786-811`. This made PR #5596 fail `Internal: AI Review & Autofix` six times (run 36705168693: `Resolver scope check failed closed (ValueError).`).

## Changes

- `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`
  - `RESOLVER_MODEL_INDEX_FILE` and `_resolver_model_index_prepare` (≈`:540-560`). Each attempt removes the stale copy and its `.lock`, copies the real index (`git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index`) to `${RUNTIME_DIR}/resolver_model_index`, and verifies the copy with `cmp`. A relative path, a missing index, or a failed copy returns non-zero.
  - Retry loop (≈`:2299-2305`): after `_resolver_scope_state capture`, the loop prepares the copy (or exits 1 with `refusing to invoke model.`) and prefixes `resolver_opencode_cmd` with `env GIT_INDEX_FILE=<copy>`. Only the model process tree sees the copy; the wrappers, both scope checks, and the script's own staging and commit use the real index.
  - `_resolver_disable_opencode_snapshot` (≈`:484-523`) sets `snapshot: false` in the resolver-only OpenCode config before `opencode_require_bootstrap` validates it. OpenCo

2026-09-30T11:54:59.3873145Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5627-resolver-private-model-index-plan.md` (progress log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5627-resolver-private-model-index.md`; final PR #5637).

The source-repo conflict resolver failed closed whenever its model ran `git add` on the permitted conflicted file. The model shared the live merge index, and both attempt-scope guards require that index to stay unchanged. `_resolver_scope_state` hashes the index at `:585-587` of the pre-fix script, and `_resolver_attempt_state` checks `ls-files --stage` at `:786-811`. This made PR #5596 fail `Internal: AI Review & Autofix` six times (run 36705168693: `Resolver scope check failed closed (ValueError).`).

2026-09-30T11:43:53.0578944Z   pr_body: ## Summary

This is the integration PR for the `/implement-issue-claude` project for #4665. The project branch `claude/implement-plan-issue-4665-reissue-new-output-paths` collects the phase PR and the conformance fix PR. Every stage has passed: the phase, the conformance audit, and runtime validation. The security pass is skipped because this is an `ai:workflow-heal` issue.

A review-blocked `close_and_reissue` with `reissue_mode: spot-fix` can now declare a top-level `new_output_paths` list (files the follow-up must create, such as a changelog fragment). `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` validates each entry (printable ASCII, no globs or trailing `/`, absent at the closed head, cap 10) and unions the survivors into the reissue's `files_touched` allowlist, so the implement-time scope guard no longer latches `ai:scope-blocked` on them. A reissue without the field is byte-identical to before.

- Plan: `docs/completed/issue-4665-reissue-new-output-paths-plan.md`
- Progress log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-4665-reissue-new-output-paths.md`
- Base: `stable`, from the issue's `Target branch:` line. After this merges, the final-merge stage closes #4665 and labels it `ai:merged`. `forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml` then carries the fix to `main`.

Four paths in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` turned a merged PR with a closing keyword into merged state for an issue. None of them checked which branch the PR merged into or who pushed its head. An unrelated PR saying `Fixes #<n>`, merged into the wrong branch, could therefore force `ai:merged` on a wave child and mark it `merged` in `check-wave-status`, which could advance its wave.

The fix adds `_pr_json_merged_into_issue_target`, the rule `close_merged_issues_sweep` already applies (#4813, #5226). A merge counts in two cases:
- it landed on the default branch (read from the same PR JSON; an empty value fails closed);
- it landed on one of the issue's target branches, from an automation head for that issue (`pr_head_ref_is_issue_automation_branch`) in this repository.

All four paths now go through it:

| `refresh_validation_dispatch_wave_gate` | the state's integration branch | the entry becomes `{state: "unknown", merged: false}`, logged with `path=validation_dispatch_gate` |

2026-09-30T11:52:18.5082958Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5619-tracking-lineage-completion-pr-only-plan.md`. It fixes security audit finding #5619 (STRIDE: Tampering, medium) at `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:557`.

**The defect.** The `Update linked issue labels when PR closes` step queued every linked `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue for lineage finalization, whatever the PR was. Any merged PR that linked a tracker therefore made `Finalize linked issue lineage state` write the project's AI-memory lineage as `merged` while the project was still active. That includes a child PR merged into `orchestrator/project-<T>` and an unrelated merge. An unmerged close wrote it as `closed`.

**The fix.** A tracking issue `<T>` is now finalized only by its completion PR. That means `PR_MERGED=true`, `PR_BASE_REF` equal to the default branch (from the event payload), `PR_HEAD_REF` equal to `orchestrator/project-<T>`, and `PR_HEAD_REPO_FULL_NAME` equal to this repository. Every other PR logs why and leaves the lineage alone. An issue whose classification lookups both failed may be a tracker, so it follows the same rule. The fix adds no API calls; everything comes from the event payload.

## Proactive fixes included

- **Tracking issue could be labelled `ai:merged` and closed** (`.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`, per-issue REST fallback; found while implementing and recorded as AD-6).
  - The cause: the fallback appended to `TRACKING_ISSUES` / `MANAGED_ISSUES` with `+=`, but the list built from the `closingIssuesReferences` payload has no trailing newline. `5` plus a failed lookup of `10` became `510`.
  - T
